english_policy.waiver_notes: If English is not your first language you must provide proof. A waiver may be possible if you attended four years of secondary school in English full-time, or two years of an Ontario college in English full-time, or one year of university in English full-time (classes in English, academic courses, no ESL courses, and Grade 12 English if the school is in Canada). Western may ask anyone for proof. Tests must be written before March 2027 and not before January 1, 2025; results are due by mid April 2027.

english.notes: IELTS Academic; scores must be sent electronically by the test centre. A lower score (5.5 overall) can lead to the English Boost Program.
